Looking at this problem, I need to find the number of race result records for the constructor "brawn" in the 2009 season, but only considering races that occurred before 2009-07-01 (as-of temporal constraint within the 2009 year window).

Let me also consider the "declaration time point" of 2011-03-01 — this means the data should be available as of that date, but since we're looking at 2009 data, all 2009 race results would be available by 2011-03-01, so this constraint is naturally satisfied.

The "as-of 2009-07-01 所在年窗" means we look at the year window of the date 2009-07-01, which is the year 2009, but constrained to data as-of 2009-07-01 — meaning races with date < '2009-07-01' (or <= depending on interpretation). Following the as-of discipline, we should include records up to but not beyond 2009-07-01.

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."results" r JOIN main."constructors" c ON r."constructorId" = c."constructorId" JOIN main."races" ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId" WHERE c."constructorRef" = 'brawn' AND ra."year" = 2009 AND ra."date" < '2009-07-01';
```
